biocs.name: Suspicious ICMP Packet
biocs.description: Detects ping commands sending data to test-net IP
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'ping.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'

abiocs.name: PowerShell Ping C2 Activity
abiocs.description: Detects PowerShell invoking ping to test-net IP for C2
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data

| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'
